criteria.description: When productId changes from null to a non-null value (panel opens), document.activeElement must be the close button by the time the first paint completes.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx line 57-65: useLayoutEffect with [isOpen] dependency. When isOpen is true, executes panelRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.detail-close-btn')?.focus(). The button at line 127-134 has className='detail-close-btn' and aria-label='Close panel'. useLayoutEffect fires synchronously after DOM mutation before paint.

criteria.description: While the panel is open, pressing Tab when the last focusable element has focus must move focus to the first focusable element and not allow focus to leave the panel.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx lines 68-96: document.addEventListener('keydown', handler). Handler at lines 74-88: checks event.key === 'Tab' && !event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last, then calls event.preventDefault() and first.focus(). FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR (line 12-13) matches the required selector exactly.

criteria.description: While the panel is open, pressing Shift+Tab when the first focusable element has focus must move focus to the last focusable element inside the panel.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx lines 85-88: same keydown handler checks event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first, then calls event.preventDefault() and last.focus().

criteria.description: Pressing Escape at any time while the panel is open must call onClose, regardless of which element on the page currently has focus.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx line 92: document.addEventListener('keydown', handler) — attached to document (not a JSX onKeyDown). Handler lines 72-73: checks event.key === 'Escape' and calls onClose().

criteria.description: The element that held focus immediately before the panel opened must receive focus again when the panel closes. The previous-focus element must be captured at open time, not close time.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx lines 57-65: useLayoutEffect with [isOpen] dependency. When isOpen becomes true (line 58): reads document.activeElement and stores in previousFocusRef.current. Cleanup function (lines 63-65) runs when isOpen becomes false and calls (previousFocusRef.current as HTMLElement | null)?.focus(). Capture is in the if(isOpen) branch (open time), not the cleanup.

criteria.description: The document keydown listener added for the Escape handler must be removed when the panel closes and when the component unmounts.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx lines 92-95: document.addEventListener('keydown', handler) followed by return () => { document.removeEventListener('keydown', handler); }. The handler variable is defined in the same effect closure, so the same reference is used for both add and remove.

criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx line 100: return ReactDOM.createPortal(<>...</>, document.body); — ReactDOM.createPortal is present in the return value, mounting into document.body.

criteria.description: The scroll-lock behaviour (document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden' while open, reset to '' on close) is preserved unchanged.
criteria.evidence: ProductDetailPanel.tsx lines 48-54: useEffect with [isOpen] dependency. Sets document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden' when isOpen is true. Cleanup resets document.body.style.overflow = ''.
